title: Rust SOS rate limiter fails open for public non-default limits
description: P3 security review finding in newly added rust/lichen-link/src/sos.rs (completed implementation project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.10.7.3.2). SosRateLimitConfig::new and public fields accept arbitrary max_per_hour and burst_allowance, but SosRateLimitState stores only [u64; 3]. If max_per_hour > 3, valid_count can never reach the configured threshold and the hourly limit is disabled; if max_per_hour == 0 with no stored entry, the >= check finds no oldest timestamp and then falls through to Allowed (especially with burst_remaining > 0). A burst_allowance up to 255 likewise defeats the stated burst cap. Make construction validated/fallible or size storage from an enforced maximum, reject zero/out-of-range normative settings, and add max=0, max=4, large-burst, and check-after-prune tests.
